text:
Maya Chen: Quick check — we're planning a small rollout of routing guardrails for the QuickInsights panel. Need to sync console UX (saved queries per-route/model) with the routing/quotas telemetry so fallbacks are visible. Anyone got concerns about how saved queries should reflect effective routing?

Devon K.: Do we mean the saved query should display the active routing policy (e.g. quota_aware -> fallback model) or actually lock in the route/model at save-time?

Maya Chen: Display only + optional pin override. We don't want to surprise users by changing their saved outputs, but we should surface when the routing will choose a cheaper variant. Badge + hover tooltip is fine.

Ashley R.: UX thought — show an "Effective routing" pill next to model name in the saved query card. Clicking opens a small preview that shows: current model, fallback model, threshold (tokens left), and a live estimate of cost delta. Example UI text: "Routing: quota_aware (primary: redwood-xl, fallback: redwood-small) — 12% routes currently using fallback" :chart_with_downwards_trend:

Paul Singh: Two infra notes: 1) telemetry needs to include route_id, saved_query_id, model_variant_selected, and a cost_estimate field. 2) Sampling — we should avoid full event volume on high-traffic routes. Prefer deterministic sampling by route hash. e.g.:
```
// pseudo
const samplePct = route.sample_rate || 1
const keep = (hash(route_id) % 100) < samplePct
if (keep) emit("quickinsight.routing_event", {route_id, saved_query_id, model_variant, estimate_tokens})
```

Devon K.: Agree. Also for the API we should add a lightweight endpoint: POST /console/preview-routing that returns {effective_model, fallback, reason, cost_delta}. Console can call it on hover or when opening the save modal. Keep it cached for ~30s per route.

Maya Chen: Nice. For rollout: canary 5% of routes -> 20% -> all. Metrics to watch: tokens/token-cost delta, fallback rate, user click-through on "pin override", and spike in preview API QPS.

Ashley R.: UX action: add toggle in Save Query modal: "Show routing previews for this saved query" (default on). If user opts out, we still show badge but no preview calls.

Paul Singh: One more: when a saved query is older than 30 days, re-evaluate routing assumptions before showing a preview; otherwise we might show stale fallbacks. Backend can add a small header: X-routing-stale: true/false.

infra-bot: deploy-bot scheduled the preview API service at 2026-03-23T14:00:00Z to namespace preview-api-v2. CI pipeline shows 2 warnings.

Devon K.: For telemetry event naming, propose: `quickinsight.route_routing_preview.v1` with fields: route_id, saved_query_id, model_variant, fallback_variant, timestamp, sample_rate, cost_delta_usd, client_session_id.

Maya Chen: OK. Action items:
- @Devon K. add /console/preview-routing API + cache and rate limit (canary config).
- @Ashley R. prototype the Save modal toggle + pill + hover panel.
- @Paul Singh implement deterministic sampling + add routing-stale header.
- I'll own rollout plan and dashboard panels (fallback rate, preview QPS, cost delta).

Ashley R.: I'll provide a quick Figma by EOD tomorrow.

Paul Singh: I'll PR sampling helper and env var for default sample_pct = 1.

Devon K.: I'll stub the API with a mock response so Ashley can hook the UX without infra rollout.

Maya Chen: Thanks — let's sync in the morning stand if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
